segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَى رَسُولِ الله وَ عَلَى ذُرِّيَّةِ رَسُولِ الله وَ رَحْمَةُ الله وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَى الْعَبْدِ الصَّالِحِ الْمُطِيعِ لله رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ وَ لِرَسُولِهِ وَ لِأَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ابْنَ السِّبْطِ الْمُنْتَجَبِ الْمُجْتَبَى

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ عَرَّفَ الله بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَكُمْ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَ حَشَرَنَا فِي زُمْرَتِكُمْ

segments.translation: to lead us to your grandfather's fountain and quench our thirst out of it, with Muá¸¥ammad's own cup in Ali's hand, Allah Bless you All

segments.transliteration: as`alu aullaaha ayn yoreyanaa feekomus soroora wall faraja
segments.translation: I ask Allah to grant us, through you, happiness, ease

segments.translation: I seek Allah's nearness through my love for you and through my enmity for you enemies my surrender to Allah willingly, not unwillingly, my acceptance,

O the (ever) existing who is a priori to all existence; O the creator (who says âbeâ and it becomes) of all things, O the everlasting eternal even when everything (created) shall perish:

segments.arabic:
يَا كَائِنًا قَبْلَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ

 وَ يَا مُكَوِّنَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ء

ٍ وَ يَا بَاقِي بَعْدَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ء

ٍ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ افْعَلْ بِيْ
segments.transliteration: yaa kaaa-inan qabla kulli shay -in wa yaa mukawwina kulli shay -in wa yaa baaqiya ba'da kulli shay -in s'alli ala muh'ammadin wa ahli baytihee waf-a'l bee
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him. I seek protection of Allah and I beseech Him to give me His bounties generously.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ وَاَسْألَهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ
segments.transliteration: subh'aanallaahil a'z'eemi wa bih'amdihee astaghfirullaaahaa wa as-aluhoo min faz'lihee
segments.translation: I enumerate the merits of all that which are glorious and magnificent (to know that) there is no god save Allah; and for (removal of) pains and sorrows there is no power nor strength (in any) save in Allah. Muhammad is the first light, Ali the second light; and all the pious Imams (of the Ahlul Bayt) are a means to reach the presence of Allah and a protection from the enemies of Allah. All things are dwarfed in presence of the greatness of Allah. I seek sufficient (support) from Allah, the mighty, the glorious.

segments.arabic: اَعْدَدْتُ لِكُلِِّ عَظِيْمَةٍ لَآ اِله اِلاَّ اللهُ وَ لِكُلِِّ هَمٍٍّ وَ غَمِِِّ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ اِلاَّ باِللهِ مُحَمَّدٌ نُوْرُ الْاوَّلُ وَ عَلِىٌّ نُوْرُ الثَّانِىْ وَ الْاَءِمَّةُ الْاَبْرَارُ عُدَّةٌ لِلِقَآءِ اللهِ وَ حِجَابٌ مِنْ اَعْدَآءِ اللهِ ذَلَّ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ لِعَظَمَةِ اللهِ وَأَسْأَلُ اللهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ الْكِفَايَةَ
segments.transliteration: a'-dadtu likulli a'z'eematin laa ilaaha illallaahu wa likulli hammin wa ghammin laa h'awla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah muh'ammadun noorul awwalu wa a'liyaun nooruth thaanee wal a-immatul abraaru u'ddatun liliqaaa-illaahi wa h'ijaabun min a-daaa-illaahi d'alla kulli shay-in li-a'z'amatillaahi wa as-alullaaha a'zza wa jallal kifaayah
segments.translation: O Allah, if my sins have blackened my face, I turn to You through Your prophet, Muhammad, the prophet of mercy, blessings of Allah be on him and on his children, (and through) Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, Husayn and the (rest of the) Imams (of the Ahl ul Bayt), peace be on all of them.

segments.arabic: اَلَّلهُمَّ اِنْ كَانَتْ ذَنُوْبِىْ قَدْ اَخْلَقَتْ وَجْهِیْ عِنْدَكَ فَاِنِِّیْ اَتَوَجَّهُ اِلَيْكَ نَبِىِِّ الرَّحْمَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اَلِهِ وَ عَلِىِِِّ وَ فَاطِمَةَ وَالْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ وَ الْأِمَّةِ عَلَيْهِمْ السَلَامُ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma in kaanat d'unoobee qad akhlaqat wajhee i'ndaka fa innee atawajjahu ilayka bi nabiyyika nabiyyir rah'mati muhammadin s'allallaahu a'layhi wa aalihee wa a'liyyin wa faat'imata walah'asani wal h'usayni wal a-immati a'layhimus salaam
segments.translation: Allah suffices me. There is no god but He. On Him do I rely, and He is the Lord of the great throne.

segments.arabic: حَسْبِىَ اللهُ لَآ اٍلَهَ اِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ-
segments.transliteration: h'asbiyallaahu laaa ilaaha illaa huw a'layhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul a'rshil a'z'eem.
segments.translation: I entrust my affair to Allah, verily, Allah keeps an eye on (His) servants.

segments.arabic: وَ أُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِيْ إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيْرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ
segments.transliteration: wa ufawwiz'u amree ilallaah innallaaha bas'eerum bil ibaad
segments.translation: There is no god save You. Glory be to You. Verily I was of there unjust. Then We responded to him and delivered him from grief, thus do We deliver the believers.

segments.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّيْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهٗ وَ نَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَ كَذٰلِكَ نُنْجِي الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: laa ilaaha illaaa anta subh'aanaka innee kuntu minaz'z'aalimeen fas-tajabnaa lahoo wa najjaynaahu minal ghamm wa kad'aalika nunjil moomineen
segments.translation: Allah is sufficient for us; and most excellent is He (who) protects us.
There is no power and no strength save with Allah the high, the great.

segments.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: LAA H'AWLA WA LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAAHIL A'LIYYIL A'Z'EEM
segments.translation: O Allah, give us welfare from wheresoever You desire, as You wish and when You want. Verily You do that which You find satisfying because it pleases You.

segments.arabic: اَلَّلهُمَّ اَتِنِىْ بِالْعَافِيَةِ مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتَ وَ كَيْفَ شِئْتَ وَ اَنَّی شِئْتَ فَاِنَّكَ تَفْعَلُ مَا شِئْتَ كَيْفَ شِئْتَ-
segments.transliteration: allaahumma aatinee bin a'afiyati min h'aythu shi-ta wa kayfa shi-ta wa annaa shi-ta fa-innaka taf-a'lu maa shi-ta kayfa shi-ta
segments.translation:
O Allah, verily You, unto those who love You, are more loving than any who loves; You are ever at hand to fulfill atonce the desires of those who rely on You; You take notice of their wishes, You perceive their innermost thoughts, You know the depth of their intelligence. You are fully aware of their confidential concerns. There hearts long for (relief from) You. Whenever miserable and forsaken Your remembrance comfort them in distress. Whenever misfortunes assult them, they turn to You, knowing well that the reins of all affairs are in Your hand and every affair rise from and flow out as soon as Your decision is made. O my Allah, if I falter in speaking my request and wander astray in describing my needs and wants, show me the way that leads to that which promotes my interests and turn my heart to its course, because it is neither against (the principles of) Your guidance nor Your act of giving succour can be described as unlikely.
O my Allah, support me with Your pardon, do not burden me with Your justice.

segments.arabic: اَلَّلهُمَّ اِنَّكَ اَنَسُ اَنِسِيْنَ لِاَوْلِيَآئِكَ وَ اَحْضَرَهُمْ بِالْكِفَايَةِ لِلْمُتَوَكِِّلِيْنَ عَلَيْكَ تُشَاهِدُهُمْ فِىْ سَرَائِرِهِمْ وَ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَيْهِمْ فِىْ ضَمَائِرِهِمْ وَ تَعْلَمُ سَبْلَغَ بَصَئِرِهِمْ فَاَسْرَرَهُمْ لَكَ مَكْشُوْفَةٌ وَ قُلُوبُهُمْ اِلَيْكَ مُلْهُوفَةٌ اِنْ اَوْ حَشَتْهُمُ اَلْغُرْبَةُ اَنَسَهُمْ ذِكْرُك وَ اِنْ صَبَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ الْمَصَائِبُ لَجَآئُا اِلَى الْاِسْتِجَارَةِ بِكَ عِلْمًا بِاَنَّ اَزِمَّةِ الْاَمُوْرِ بِيَدِكَ بِمَصَادِرَهَا عَنْ قَضَآئِكَ- اَلَّلهُمَّ اِنْ فَهَهْتُ عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِىْ اَوْ عَمِهْتُ عَنْ طَلِبَتِىْ فَدُلَّنِىْ عَلىَ مَصَالِحِیْ وَ خُذْ بِقَلْبِىْ اِلىَ مَرَاشِدِىْ فَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ بِنُکْرِ مِنْ هِدَايَاتِكَ وَلاَ بِبَدَعٍ مِنْ كِفَايَاتِكَ- اَلَّلهُمَّ احْمِلْنِىْ عَلىَ عَفْوِك وَلاَ تَحْمِلْنِىْ عَلىَ عَدْلِكَ-
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma innaka annisul aaneeseena li-awliyaa-ika wa ah'z"uruhum bil kifaayati lil mutawakkileena a'layka tashhaduhum fee sarra-irihim wea tat't'ali-u fee z"amaa--irihim wa ta'lamu mablagha bas'aa-irihim fa-asraaruhum laka makshoofatun wa quloobuhum ilayka malhoofatun in awh'ashat-humul ghurbatu aanasahum d'ikruka wa in s'ubbat a'layhimul mas'aa-ibu lajaaa-u ilal istijaarati bika i'lman bi-anna a'z'eematal umoori biyadika wa mas'aadirahaa a'n qaz" aaa-ika allaahumma in fahah-tu mas-alatee aw a'mihtu a'n t'alibatee fadullanee a'laa mas'aalih'ee wa khud' biqalbee ilaa maraashidee fa laysa d'aalika binukrin min hidaayatika wa laa bibad-i'n min kifaayatika allaahummah-malnee a'laa a'fwika wa laa tah'milnee a'laa a'dlika
segments.translation: O God, verily You are the closest companion to Your friends (saints),
and You are present with sufficiency for those who rely upon You.
You witness them in their innermost thoughts,
and You are aware of what is in their consciences,
and You know the extent of their insights.
So, their secrets are revealed to You,
and their hearts yearn towards You.
If loneliness makes them feel desolate, Your remembrance comforts them,
and if calamities pour down upon them,
they turn to seek Your protection,
knowing that the reins of all affairs are in Your Hand,
with their origin stemming from Your decree.
O God, if I become confused about my request,
or become unaware of what I truly need,
then guide me to what is beneficial for me,
and take my heart towards what is right for me,
for that is not unheard of among Your guidance,
nor is it an innovation among Your fulfillments.
O God, bear with me with Your pardon,
and do not bear with me with Your justice.
O Pillar of him who has no pillar,

segments.arabic: يَا عِمادَ مَنْ لا عِمادَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: YÄ âImÄda man lÄ âimÄda lah
segments.translation: and O Treasure of him who has no treasure,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا ذُخْرَ مَنْ لَا ذُخْرَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ Dhukhra man lÄ dhukhra lah
segments.translation: and O Support of him who has no support,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا سَنَدَ مَنْ لَا سَنَدَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ Sanada man lÄ sanada lah
segments.translation: and O Sanctuary of him who has no sanctuary,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا حِرْزَ مَنْ لَا حِرْزَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ á¸¤irza man lÄ á¸¥irza lah
segments.translation: and O Succour of him who has no succour,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا غِيَاثَ مَنْ لَا غِيَاثَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ GhiyÄtha man lÄ ghiyÄtha lah
segments.translation: and O Treasure of him who has no treasure,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا كَنْزَ مَنْ لَا كَنْزَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ Kanza man lÄ kanza lah
segments.translation: and O Honour of him who has no honour,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا عِزَّ مَنْ لَا عِزَّ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ âIzza man lÄ âizza lah
segments.translation: O Generous in Forgiveness,
O Excellent in Overlooking (sins),
O Helper of the weak,
O Treasure of the poor,
O Great in Hope,
O Rescuer of the drowned,
O Deliverer of the perished,
O Benefactor,
O Beautifier (Giver of Grace),
O Bestower of blessings,
O Giver of abundance,
You are the One to Whom the darkness of the night prostrates,

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ الَّذِي سَجَدَ لَكَ سَوادُ اللَّيْلِ
segments.transliteration: Anta l-ladhÄ« sajada laka sawÄdu l-layl
segments.translation: and the light of the day,
and the brightness of the moon,
and the ray of the sun,
and the rustling of the trees,
and the humming (rushing sound) of the water.
O God, O God, O God,

segments.arabic: يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ
segments.transliteration: YÄ AllÄhu yÄ AllÄhu yÄ AllÄh
segments.translation: there is no god but You, You alone, there is no partner for You.

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
segments.transliteration: lÄ ilÄha illÄ Anta waá¸¥daka lÄ sharÄ«ka lak
segments.translation: O My Lord! O God!
Bless Muá¸¥ammad and the Family of Muá¸¥ammad,

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: and deal with us as is befitting of You.

segments.arabic: وَ افْعَلْ بِنَا مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa fâal binÄ mÄ Anta ahluh.
segments.translation: Then ask for your need.

-this (and) this-and you were not (present) in the western side when We sent our command to Musa, neither you were there to witness. O accursed, go away by the power of Allah, and by the honour of the Lord of the worlds. Get out imprisoned. Get out from this. It is not for you to show pride here, so get out, verily you are of those despised. Get out of this, despised, driven away; accursed as We cursed the people of the Sabbath, and the command of Allah is always executed. Get out, O afflicted. Get out O Sooran O Sooran in the name of that name which is kept secret, O Tatâaaroon Tâaroon Mar-oâon. Blessings be for Allah who is the best creator. O Hayaa, O Hayaa, in the name of the everliving ever-subsisting name which is written on the forehead of Israafeel disappear at once from the holder of this written text, (whoever it may be) a genie (male or female), a devil (male or female) or a follower of (the devil, male or female), a sorcerer or sorcersess, a demon (male or female), a juggler or a trickster, whoever endangers the lives of the sons of Adam and daughters of Hawwaa. There is no power and strength (with any one) save with Allah, the highest, the greatest. Blessings of Allah be on Muhammad and on his pure, purified, and infallible children.

segments.arabic: ی کنوش ارکنوش اره شش عطبیطسفينخ یَا مططرون قریالسيون وما سوما سوما طيطسالوس خبظوس مسفقيس مسا معوش افرطیعوش لطيفکش لطیفوش هَذَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنْتَ بِجَانِبِ الْغَرْبِىِِّ اِذْ قَضَيْنَا اِلىَ مُوْسَى الْاَمْرَ وَمَا كُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُشَاهِدِيْنَ اُخْرُجْ بِقُدْرَةِ اللهِ مِنْهَا اَيُّهَا الْلَّعِيْنُ بِعزَّةِ اللهِ رَبِِّ الْعْاَمِيْنَ اُخْرُجْ مِنْهَا وَ اِلاَّ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِيْنَ اُخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُوْنُ لَكَ اَنْ تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيْهَا فَاخْرُجْ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الصَّاغِرِيْنَ اُخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مُذْئُوْمًا مَدْحُوْرًا مَلْعُوْنًا كَمَا لَعَنَّا اَصْحَابَ السَّبْتِ وَ كَانَ اَمْرُ اللهِ مَفْعُوْلاً اُخْرُجْ يَا ذَوِىْ الْمَحْزُوْنَ اُخْرُجْ یَا سُوْرًا یَا سُوْرًا سُوْرٌ بِالاِسْمِ الْمَحْتزُوْنِ يَا طَطَرُونَ طَرْعُوْنَ مَرَعُوْنَ تَبَارَكَ اللهُ اَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِيْنَ یَا هَيَا يَا هَيَا شَرَاهِيَّا حَيَّا قَيُّومًا بِالاِسْمِ الْمَكْتُوْبُ عَلىَ جَبْهَةِ اِسْرَافِيْلَ اَطْرُدُوْا عَنْ صَاحِبِ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ كُلَّ جِنِِّىٍ وَ جِنَيَّةٍ وَ شَيْطَانٍ وَ شَیْطَانَةٍ وَتَابِعٍ وَ تَابِعَةٍ وَ صَاحِرٍ وَ صَاحِرَةٍ وَ غَوْلٍ وَ غَوْلَةٍ
segments.transliteration: iykanoosh arkanoosh arahshah a'tbeetas faneekh yaa matt'aroon qaryaa laysiyoon maa wa maa soomaa soomaa taytasaaloos khabt'oos musfaqees masaama-o'osh afartee-o'osh lateefakash lat'eefoosh haad'aa haad'aa wa maa kunta bijaanibil gharibbee id'qaz"aynaa ilaa moosal amra wa maa kunta minashshaahi deenaa ukhruj biqudratillaahi minhaa ayyuhal la-e'enu bi-i'zzatillaahi rabbil a'alameen ukhruj minhaa wa illaa kunta minal masjooneena ukhruj minhaa famaa yakoonu laka an tatakabbara feehaa fakhruj innaka minas' s'aaghireen ukhruj minhaa mad-ooman madh'ooran mal-o'onan kamaa la-a'nnaa as'h'aabas sabri wa kaana amrullaahi maf-o'olan ukhruj yaa d'awil mah'zoona ukhruj yaa sooran yaa sooran yuaa sooran bil ismil makhzooni yaa t'at'aroon tar -o'on maraa - o'on tabaarakallaahu ah'sanul hiyyaa h'ayyan qayyooman bil-ismil maktoobi a'laa jabhati israafeela ut'rudoo a'n s'aah'ibi haad'al kitaabi kulla jinnin wa jinniyyatin shayt'aanin wa shayt'aanatin wa taabi-i'n wa taabi-a'tin wa saah'irin wa saah'iratin wa ghoolin wa ghoolatin wa kulla muta-a'bbithin wa a'abithin yaa'bathu bibni aadama wa binaati h'awwaa wa laa h'awla wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil a'liyyil a'z'eem wa s'allallaahu a'laa muh'ammadin wa aalihee ajma-e'enat tayyibeenat t'aahireenal maa'soomeen
segments.translation: O Humiliator of all tyrants! O Dignifier of all humble ones! I, swearing by You, have exerted all efforts; so, send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household and relieve me.[1]

segments.arabic: يَا مُذِلَّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيْدٍ يَا مُعِزَّ كُلِّ ذَلِيْلٍ قَدْ وَ حَقِّكَ بَلَغَ مَـجْهُوْدِيْ فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهٖ وَ فَرِّجْ عَنِّيْ.
segments.transliteration: yaa mozilla kulle jabbaarin aâneedin yaa o-iâzza kulle zaleelin qad wa haqqeqa balagha majhoodee fa-salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aalehi wa farrij aânnee.
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, Praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, He is One and there are no partners for Him, He is Living, and He will not die, all good is through Him, and He has power over all things

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَ الْـحَمْدُ لِلهِ وَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَ لَهُ الْـحَمْدُ يُـحْيِيْ وَ يُـمِيْتُ وَ هُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَـمُوْتُ بِيَدِهِ الْـخَيْرُ وَ هُوَ عَلٰى‏ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيْر
segments.transliteration: subhaanal laahe wal hamdo lillaahe wa laa elaaha illal laaho wahdahu laa shareeka lahu lahul mulko wa lahul hamdo yohyee wa yomeeto wa howa hayyun laa yamooto beyadehil khayro wa howa aâlaa kulle shayin qadeer.
segments.translation:
.
There are no means and no power without Allah the Most High, the Most Great.

segments.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil aâliyyi
segments.translation: O Allah! I implore You in by the right of Your friend, Ali Ibn Moosa al-Reza (a.s.) to secure me during my journeys; in lands and seas, on mountains and in plains, in valleys and in jungles, against all that which I fear or anticipate. Certainly You are All-Kind and All-Merciful.[3]

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِـحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوْسَى الرِّضَا اِلَّا مَا سَلَّمْتَنِيْ بِهٖ فِيْ جَـمِيْعِ اَسْفَارِيْ فِيْ الْبَرَارِيْ وَ الْبِحَارِ وَ الْـجِبَالِ وَ الْقِفَارِ وَ الْاَوْدِيَةِ وَ الْغِيَاضِ مِنْ جَـمِيْعِ مَا اَخَافُهٗ وَ اَحْذَرُهٗ اِنَّكَ رَءُوْفٌ رَحِيْمٌ.‏
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-aloka be-haqqe waliyyeka aâliy yibne moosar rezaa illaa maa sallamtanee behi fee jamee-eâ asfaaree fil baraaree wal behaare wal jebaale wal qefaare wal aw-deyate wal gheyaaze min jamee-eâ maa akhaafohu wa ahzarohu innaka raoofur raheem.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, I believe in Allah, I place my trust in Allah, as Allah wills. There are no means and no power without Allah.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ آمَنْتُ بِاللهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ مَا شَاءَ اللهُ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ
segments.transliteration: bismil laahe aamanto bil-laahe tawakkalto aâlal laahe maa shaa allaaho laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, I have come out, in the name of Allah, I enter, in Allah I have placed my trust, and there are no means and no power without Allah the Most High, the Most Great.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ خَرَجْتُ وَ بِسْمِ اللهِ وَلَـجْتُ وَ عَلَى اللهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ‏
segments.transliteration: bismil laahe kharajto wa bismil laahe walajto wa aâlal laahe tawakkalto wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa bil-laahil aâliyyil aâzeem.
segments.translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

O Allah! My many sins have made me lose face before You, prevented me from being worthy of Your mercy, and kept me away from deserving Your forgiveness! I have adhered to Your boons and clung to supplicating You, for You have promised those who are like me in acting extravagantly (against their own souls), making errors, and despairing of Your mercy through Your words: âSay: O My servants who have acted extravagantly against their own souls, do not despair of the mercy of Allah; surely Allah forgives the faults altogether; surely He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.â[9] You have warned those who despair of Your mercy and said: âAnd who despairs of the mercy of his Lord but the erring ones.â[10] Then You have summoned us through Your mercy to supplicate You, thus You have said: âCall upon me, I will answer you; surely those who are too proud for My mercy shall soon enter hell abased.â[11] O my Lord! Hopelessness has covered me, and despair of Your mercy has wrapped me! O my Lord! You have promised to reward him who has good opinion in You and to punish him who has bad opinion in You! O Allah! My eye has been seized by good opinion of You in releasing my neck from the Fire, covering my slips, releasing (me) from my stumble! O Allah! Your words, which have neither alteration nor change, are true: â(Remember) the day when We will call every people with their Imam.â[12] That is the Day of Resurrection when the trumpet shall be blown and âwhat is in the graves shall be raised.â[13] O Allah! I believe, witness, confess, do not deny, do not renege, conceal, announce, manifest, and hide that You are Allah, there is no god but You, One with no partner with You, that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger, may Allah bless him and his Family, and that Ali, the Commander of the faithful, master of the testamentary trustees, inheritor of knowledge of the prophets, emblem of religion, destroyer of the hypocrites, the fighter against the Renegades (Maareqeen), my Imam, my proof, my handle, my path, my guide, and my argument. I do not trust my deeds though pure; nor do I see that they will save me though righteous but through (showing) friendship to him, following his example, acknowledging his great virtues, accepting from those who delivered them, and submitting to those who narrated them. I confess that his testamentary trustees from among his grandsons are Imams, arguments, guides, lamps, guideposts, lighthouses, masters, and pious. I believe in their secret, their openness, their outward, their inward, their present, their absent, their living, and their dead. In that there is neither doubt nor suspicion nor change when You turn away (from that). O Allah! summon me on the day of my mustering and my resurrecting through their Imamate, and save me, O My Master! From the heat of the Fires through them, and supply me with the repose of the Gardens! Surely, if You release me from the Fire, I will be one of the achievers. O Allah! I rose in the morning of this day of mine (while) I have neither confidence nor hope nor asylum nor place of flight nor shelter except those through whom I seek access to You, seeking nearness to Your Messenger Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Family, then Ali, the Commander of the faithful, al-Zahra, the mistress of the women of the worlds, al-Hasan, al-Husain, Ali, Muhammad, Jaâfar, Moosa, Ali, Muhammad, Ali, al-Hasan and the one after them who will pave the way for the hidden proof from among his children, hoped for the community after him. O Allah! Make them in this day and after it my fortress against detested things and my stronghold against fears; save me through them from every enemy, tyrant, oppressor, sinner, the evil of what I know, what I deny, what has hidden from me, what I see, and the evil of every crawling creature that You have taken by the forelock! Surely You are on a straight path. O Allah! Through my seeking access through them to You, seeking nearness to You through showing love for them, fortifying myself with their Imamate, open for me the doors to Your provision; spread upon me Your mercy; make Your creatures love me; turn me aside from their detest and their enmity! Verily You are powerful over everything. O Allah! There is reward for everyone (who) seek access (through them to You); there is right for all the possessors of intercession, hence by him whom You have appointed as Your friend and placed ahead my request, I ask You to make me recognize the blessing of this day of mine, this month of mine, and this year of mine! O Allah! They are my place of flight and my help during my hardship, my ease, my well-being, my tribulation, my sleep, my wakefulness, my departure, my residence, my difficulty, my facility, my openness, my secret, my morning, my evening, my movement, my habitation, my secret, and my apparent! O Allah! Through them, disappoint me not of Your favor; cut not my hope from Your mercy; disappoint me not of Your repose; tempt me not with the closure of the doors to provisions and of the ways to them; open for me an easy opening from You; appoint for me a way out from every hardship and a road for every plenty! Surely, You are the Most Merciful of the merciful. May Allah bless Muhammad and his good and pure Household! Amen, Lord of the worlds![14]

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ‏

اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ ذُنُوْبِيْ وَ كَثْرَتَهَا قَدْ اَخْلَقَتْ وَجْهِيْ عِنْدَكَ وَ حَـجَبَتْنِيْ عَنِ اسْتِيْهَالِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ بَاعَدَتْنِيْ عَنِ اسْتِيْجَابِ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ لَوْ لَا تَعَلُّقِيْ بِآلَائِكَ وَ تَـمَسُّكِيْ بِالدُّعَآءِ وَ مَا وَعَدْتَ اَمْثَالِيْ مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ وَ اَشْبَاهِيْ مِنَ الْـخَاطِئِيْنَ وَ اَوْعَدْتَ الْقَانِطِيْنَ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ بِقَوْلِكَ ’’يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِہِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَۃِ اللہِ۝۰ۭ اِنَّ اللہَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا۝۰ۭ اِنَّہٗ ہُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ‘‘ وَ حَذَّرْتَ الْقَانِطِيْنَ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ فَقُلْتَ ’’وَمَنْ يَّقْنَطُ مِنْ رَّحْمَۃِ رَبِّہٖٓ اِلَّا الضَّاۗلُّوْنَ‘‘ ثُمَّ نَدَبْتَنَا بِرَاْفَتِكَ اِلٰى دُعَآئِكَ فَقُلْتَ ’’اُدْعُوْنِيْٓ اَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ۝۰ۭ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِيْ سَيَدْخُلُوْنَ جَہَنَّمَ دٰخِرِيْنَ‘‘ اِلٰهِيْ لَقَدْ كَانَ ذٰلِكَ الْاِيَاسُ عَلَيَّ مُشْتَمِلًا وَ الْقُنُوْطُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مُلْتَحِفًا. اِلٰهِيْ لَقَدْ وَعَدْتَ الْمُحْسِنَ ظَنَّهٗ بِكَ ثَوَابًا وَ اَوْعَدْتَ الْمُسِيْۗ‏ءَ ظَنَّهٗ بِكَ عِقَابًا. اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ قَدْ اَمْسَكَ رَمَقِيْ حُسْنُ الظَّنِّ بِكَ فِيْ عِتْقِ رَقَبَتِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ وَ تَغَمُّدِ زَلَّتِيْ وَ اِقَالَةِ عَثْرَتِيْ. اَللّٰهُمَّ قُلْتَ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ وَ قَوْلُكَ الْـحَقُّ الَّذِيْ لَا خُلْفَ لَهٗ وَ لَا تَبْدِيْلَ ’’يَوْمَ نَدْعُوْا كُلَّ اُنَاسٍؚبِـاِمَامِہِمْ‘‘ وَ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ النُّشُوْرِ اِذَا نُفِخَ فِيْ الصُّوْرِ وَ ’’بُعْثِرَ ما فِيْ الْقُبُوْرِ‘‘ اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاِنِّيْ اَوْفٰي وَ اَشْهَدُ وَ اَقِرُّ وَ لَا اُنْكِرُ وَ لَا اَجْـحَدُ وَ اُسِرُّ وَ اُعْلِنُ وَ اُظْهِرُ وَ اُبْطِنُ بِاَنَّكَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ وَ اَنَّ مُـحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُوْلُكَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِہٖ وَ اَنَّ عَلِيًّا اَمِيْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ سَيِّدُ الْاَوْصِيَآءِ وَ وَارِثُ عِلْمِ الْاَنْبِيَآءِ عَلَمُ الدِّيْنِ وَ مُبِيْرُ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ وَ مُـمَيِّزُ الْمُنَافِقِيْنَ وَ مُـجَاهِدُ الْمَارِقِيْنَ وَ اِمَامِيْ وَ حُـجَّتِيْ وَ عُرْوَتِيْ وَ صِرَاطِيْ وَ دَلِيْلِيْ وَ حُـجَّتِيْ وَ مَنْ لَا اَثِقُ بِاَعْمَالِيْ وَ لَوْ زَكَتْ وَ لَا اَرَاهَا مُنْجِيَةً لِيْ وَ لَوْ صَلُحَتْ اِلَّا بِوِلَايَتِهٖ وَ الْاِئْتِـمَامِ بِهٖ وَ الْاِقْرَارِ بِفَضَآئِلِهٖ وَ الْقَبُوْلِ مِنْ حَمَلَتِهَا وَ التَّسْلِيْمِ لِرُوَاتِهَا وَ اُقِرُّ بِاَوْصِيَآئِهٖ مِنْ اَبْنَآئِهٖ اَئِـمَّةً وَ حُـجَجًا وَ اَدِلَّةً وَ سُرُجًا وَ اَعْلَامًا وَ مَنَارًا وَ سَادَةً وَ اَبْرَارًا وَ اُوْمِنُ بِسِرِّهِمْ وَ جَهْرِهِمْ وَ ظَاهِرِهِمْ وَ بَاطِنِهِمْ وَ شَاهِدِهِمْ وَ غَآئِبِهِمْ وَ حَيِّهِمْ وَ مَيِّتِهِمْ لَا شَكَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ وَ لَا ارْتِيَابَ عِنْدَ تَـحَوُّلِكَ وَ لَا انْقِلَابَ. اَللّٰهُمَّ فَادْعُنِيْ يَوْمَ حَشْرِيْ وَ نَشْرِيْ بِاِمَامَتِهِمْ وَ اَنْقِذْنِيْ بِهِمْ يَا مَوْلَايَ مِنْ حَرِّ النِّيْرَانِ وَ اِنْ لَمْ تَرْزُقْنِيْ رُوْحَ الْـجِنَانِ فَاِنَّكَ اِنْ اَعْتَقْتَنِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ كُنْتُ مِنَ الْفَآئِزِيْنَ. اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ قَدْ اَصْبَحْتُ يَوْمِيْ هٰذَا لَا ثِقَةَ لِيْ وَ لَا رَجَآءَ وَ لَا لَـجَاَ وَ لَا مَفْزَعَ وَ لَا مَنْجٰى غَيْرَ مَنْ تَوَسَّلْتُ بِهِمْ اِلَيْكَ مُتَقَرِّبًا اِلٰى رَسُوْلِكَ مُـحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ ثُمَّ عَلِيٍّ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الزَّهْرَآءِ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَآءِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ وَ الْـحَسَنِ وَ الْـحُسَيْنِ وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ جَعْفَرٍ وَ مُوْسٰى وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ الْـحَسَنِ وَ مَنْ بَعْدَهُمْ يُقِيْمُ الْمَحَجَّةَ اِلَى الْـحُجَّةِ الْمَسْتُوْرَةِ مِنْ وُلْدِهِ الْمَرْجُوِّ لِلْاُمَّةِ مِنْ بَعْدِهٖ. اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاجْعَلْهُمْ فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَ مَا بَعْدَهٗ حِصْنِيْ مِنَ الْمَكَارِهٖ وَ مَعْقِلِيْ مِنَ الْمَخَاوِفِ وَ نَـجِّنِيْ بِهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ عَدُوٍّ وَ طَاغٍ وَ بَاغٍ وَ فَاسِقٍ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اَعْرِفُ وَ مَا اُنْكِرُ وَ مَا اسْتَتَرَ عَنِّيْ وَ مَا اَبْصُرُ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍ رَبِّيْ اٰخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا اِنَّكَ عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ. اَللّٰهُمَّ بِتَوَسُّلِيْ بِهِمْ اِلَيْكَ وَ تَقَرُّبِيْ بِـمَحَبَّتِهِمْ وَ تَـحَصُّنِيْ بِاِمَامَتِهِمْ اِفْتَحْ عَلَيَّ فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ اَبْوَابَ رِزْقِكَ وَ انْشُرْ عَلَيَّ رَحْمَتَكَ وَ حَبِّبْنِيْ اِلٰى خَلْقِكَ وَ جَنِّبْنِيْ بُغْضَهُمْ وَ عَدَاوَتَهُمْ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى‏ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيْرٌ. O God, verily my sins, and their great number,

And were it not for my clinging to Your blessings,
and my holding fast to supplication,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَعْرِفُ وَ مَا أُنْكِرُ
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri mÄ aârifu wa mÄ unkir
segments.translation: and what is hidden from me and what I see,

segments.arabic: وَ مَا اسْتَتَرَ عَنِّي وَ مَا أُبْصِرُ
segments.transliteration: wa mÄ statara âannÄ« wa mÄ ubá¹£ir
segments.translation: and from the evil of every creature whose forelock my Lord seizes;

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ رَبِّي آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli dÄbbatin RabbÄ« Äkhidhun bi-nÄá¹£iyatihÄ
segments.translation: indeed, You are on a straight path.
O God, through my seeking means to You by them,
and my seeking proximity through my love for them,
and my seeking protection through their leadership,
open for me on this day the doors of Your provision,

segments.arabic: افْتَحْ عَلَيَّ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ أَبْوَابَ رِزْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: iftaá¸¥ âalayya fÄ« hÄdhÄ l-yawmi abwÄba rizqik
segments.translation: and spread Your mercy upon me,
and make me beloved to Your creation,
and keep me away from their hatred and their enmity.
Indeed, You are capable of all things.
O God, for every seeker of means there is a reward,
and for every possessor of intercession there is a right.
So, I ask You by those whom I have made my means to You,
and whom I have placed before my request,
to make me know the blessing of this day of mine,
and this month of mine, and this year of mine.

segments.arabic: وَ شَهْرِي هَذَا وَ عَامِي هَذَا
segments.transliteration: wa shahrÄ« hÄdhÄ wa âÄmÄ« hÄdhÄ
segments.translation: O God, they are my shelter and my aid

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ هُمْ مَفْزَعِي وَ مَعُونَتِي
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa hum mafzaâÄ« wa maâÅ«natÄ«
segments.translation: in my hardship and my ease,
and my well-being and my tribulation,
and my sleep and my wakefulness,
and my travel and my stay,
and my difficulty and my ease,
and my open and my secret,
and my morning and my evening,
and my movements and my resting place,
and my secret and my open.
O God, do not disappoint me through them from Your gift,

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَلَا تُخَيِّبْنِي بِهِمْ مِنْ نَائِلِكَ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma fa-lÄ tukhayyibnÄ« bihim min nÄâilik
segments.translation: and do not cut off my hope from Your mercy,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَقْطَعْ رَجَائِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ taqá¹­aâ rajÄâÄ« min raá¸¥matik
segments.translation: and do not make me despair of Your solace,
and do not try me with the closing of the doors of provisions,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَبْتَلِنِي بِانْغِلَاقِ أَبْوَابِ الْأَرْزَاقِ
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ tabtalinÄ« bi-inghilÄqi abwÄbi l-arzÄq
segments.translation: and the blockage of its paths,
and the turning away of its sources.
And open for me from Your presence an easy opening,

segments.arabic: وَ افْتَحْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَتْحًا يَسِيرًا
segments.transliteration: Wa ftaá¸¥ lÄ« min ladunka fatá¸¥an yasÄ«rÄ
segments.translation: and make for me an exit from every distress,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ كُلِّ ضَنَكٍ مَخْرَجًا
segments.transliteration: wa jâal lÄ« min kulli á¸anakin makhrajÄ
segments.translation: and a path to every amplitude.
Indeed, You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
And may God bless Muá¸¥ammad and his pure and clean progeny.

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: Wa á¹£allÄ LlÄhu âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi á¹­-á¹­ayyibÄ«na á¹­-á¹­ÄhirÄ«n
segments.translation: Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
O Compassionate, O Merciful.

I seek protection for myself in the Lord of the earth and the Lord of the heavens. I seek protection for myself in Him with Whose Name no disease causes harm. I seek protection for myself in Him Whose Name is a blessing and a healing.[16]

segments.arabic: اُعِيْذُ نَفْسِيْ بِرَبِّ الْاَرْضِ وَ رَبِّ السَّمَاءِ اُعِيْذُ نَفْسِيْ بِالَّذِيْ لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهٖ دَاءٌ اُعِيْذُ نَفْسِيْ بِالَّذِيْ اسْمُهٗ بَرَكَةٌ وَ شِفَاءٌ.
segments.transliteration: o-eâezo nafsee be-rabbil arze wa rabbis samaaa-e o-eâezo nafsee bil-lazee laa yazurro ma-aâs mehi daa-un o-eâezo nafsee bil-lazis mohu baraktun wa shefaaun.
segments.translation: O Bestower of healing and Remover of illness, send down healing for my ailment.â[17]

segments.arabic: يَا مُنْزِلَ الشِّفَاءِ وَ مُذْهِبَ الدَّاءِ اَنْزِلْ عَلٰى وَجَعِيَ الشِّفَاءِ.
segments.transliteration: yaa munzelash shefaaa-e wa muzhebad daa-e anzil aâlaa waja-eâyash shefaa-e.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Great, in the name of Allah, the Great, Lord of the Mighty Throne, but that it left and perished.[19]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الْعَظِيْمِ بِسْمِ اللهِ الْعَظِيْمِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیْمِ اِلَّا ذَہَبْتَ وَ انْقَرَضْتَ.
segments.transliteration: bismil laahil aâzeeme bismil laahil aâzeeme rabbil aârshil aâzeeme illaa zahab-ta wan qarazta.
segments.translation: With Him are the keys of the unseen, the treasures that none knows but He. He knows whatever there is on the earth and in the sea. Not a leaf does fall but with His knowledge: there is not a grain in the darkness (or depths) of the earth, nor anything fresh or dry (green or withered), but is (inscribed) in a record clear (to those who can read).[21]

segments.arabic: وَعِنْدَہٗ مَفَاتِـحُ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُہَآ اِلَّا ہُوَ۝۰ۭ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِيْ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ۝۰ۭ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِنْ وَّرَقَۃٍ اِلَّا يَعْلَمُہَا وَلَا حَبَّۃٍ فِيْ ظُلُمٰتِ الْاَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَّلَا يَابِسٍ اِلَّا فِيْ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيْنٍ۝۵۹
segments.transliteration: wa iândahu mafaatehul ghaybe laa yaâlamohaa illaa hoo, wa yaâlamo maa fil barre wal bahr, wa maa tasqoto minw waraqatin illaa yaâlamohaa wa laa habbatin fee zolomaatil arze wa laa ratbinw wa laa yaabesin illaa fee ketaabim mobeen.
segments.translation: O Allah! You guide one who is misguided and You save from blindness, and return the lost property. Bless Muhammad and his progeny and forgive me and return to me my lost property and bless Muhammad and his progeny and peace (be upon them).[22]

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّكَ تَـهْدِيْ مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ وَ تُنْجِيْ مِنَ الْعَمٰى وَ تَرُدُّ الضَّالَّةَ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَ رُدَّ ضَالَّتِيْ وَ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهٖ وَ سَلَّمَ.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innaka tahdee menaz zalaalate wa tunjee menal aâmaa wa tarudduz zaallata salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin wagh fir lee wa rudda zaal-latee wa salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aalehi wa sallam.
segments.translation: 1.O Reliever of worry! O Remover of grief!
2.O Merciful in this world and the next and Compassionate in both!
3.Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
4.relieve my worry, and remove my grief!
5.O One, O Unique, O Eternal Refuge!

segments.arabic: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ، يَا صَمَدُ،
segments.transliteration: yaa waah'idu yaaa ah'adu yaa s'amad
segments.translation: 6.O He Who has not begotten, nor has been begotten,
7.and equal to Him is not any one!
8.Preserve me, purify me, and take away my affliction!</h6
9.Here You Should Recite The Throne Verse (2:255), The Two Suras Of Taking Refuge (113-114), And Unity (112). Then Say:

segments.arabic: [وَاقْرَأْ آيَةَ الْكُرسِيّ وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ  وَقُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ وَقُلْ:]
segments.transliteration: waq-raa aaayatal-kur-see-yi wal-mua'w-wad'atay-ni wa (qul huwal-laahooo ah'ad) waqul:
segments.translation: 10.O God, I ask You with the asking of him whose neediness is intense,

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee as-aluka soo-aala man ishtad-dat faaqatuh
segments.translation: 11.whose strength is frail, whose sins are many,

segments.transliteration: wa z''au'fat qoo-watuh wa kathurat d'unoobuh
segments.translation: 12.the asking of one who finds no helper in his neediness,

segments.arabic: سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ يَجِدُ لِفَاقَتِهِ مُغِيْثاً،
segments.translation: 13.no strengthener in his frailty,
14.no forgiver of his sin other than You,
15.O Possessor of majesty and munificence!
16.I ask of You a work through which You wilt love him who works it

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَلاً تُحِبُّ بِهِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: as-aluk a'malana tuh'ib-bu bihee man a'mila bih
segments.translation: 17.and a certainty by which You wilt profit him who is certain

segments.arabic: وَيَقِيناً تَنْفَعُ بِهِ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَنَ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa yaqeenana tanfau' bihee mani as-tay-qana bihee
segments.translation: 18.with the truth of certainty concerning the execution of Your command!
19.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.translation: 20.take my soul while it is firm in sincerity,
21.cut off my need for this world,
22.make my desire for what is with You
23.become a yearning to meet You,
24.and give me true confidence in You!
25.I ask of You the good of the writ that has been made and I seek refuge with You

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ كِتَاب قَدْ خَلاَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ
segments.transliteration: as-aluka min khay-ri kitaabin qad khalaa wa au'wd'u bika
segments.translation: 26.from the evil of the writ that has been made.
27.I ask of You the fear of The worshipers,
28.the worship of those humbly fearful of You,
29.the certainty of those who have confidence in You,
30.and the confidence of those who have faith in You.
31.O God, make my desire in my asking
32.like the desire of Your friends in their asking,
33.and my fear like the fear of Your friends!
34.Employ me in Your good pleasure through works
35.in which I will not leave aside anything of Your religion

segments.arabic: عَمَلاً لاَ أَتْرُكُ مَعَهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ دِيْنِكَ
segments.translation: 36.fearing any of Your creatures!
37.God, this is my need, so make my desire for it great,

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ هَذِهِ حَاجَتِي، فَأَعْظِمْ فِيهَا رَغْبَتِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma hd'ihee h'aajatee faaa'-z'im feehaa ragh-batee
segments.translation: 38.within it make manifest my excuse, through it instil me with my argument, and by means of it make well my body!

segments.arabic: وَأَظْهِرْ فِيهَا عُذْرِي، وَلَقِّنِي فِيهَا حُجَّتِي وَعَافِ فِيْهَا جَسَدِيْ.
segments.transliteration: wa az'-hir feehaa u'd'-ree wa laq-qinee feehaa h'uj-jatee wa a'afi feehaa jasadee
segments.translation: 39.O God, some rise in the morning having trust or hope in other than You.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَصْبَحَ لَهُ ثِقَةٌ أَوْ رَجَآءٌ غَيْرُكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma man as'-bah'a lahoo thiqatun aw rajaaa-un ghay-ruk
segments.translation: 40.I rise in the morning, and You art my trust
41.and my hope in all affairs,
42.so decree for me those which are best in outcome
43.and deliver me from misguiding trials,
44.O Most Merciful of the merciful!
45.And God bless our chief, Muhammad the Messenger of God, the chosen,

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّد رُسُولِ اللهِ المُصْطَفَى،
segments.translation: 46.and his Household, the pure!

title: Hazrat Abbas Ibn Ali ( peace be upon him)
text: Hazrat Abbas Ibn Ali ( peace be upon him)       Ziyarat Hazrat Abbas Ibn Ali(as) Brief info Brief Life × BRotherhood, Courage, and Loyalty in Abbas bin Ali - By SAYYID MUHAMMAD RIZVI Who was Abbas (peace be upon him), whose birth anniversary is being celebrated this week? To the Muslims, Abbas is known in different ways: as the lion of Ali, the hero of Karbala, the flag-bearer of Hussain, the beloved brother of Zainab, and the loving uncle of Sakina (peace be upon them all). Abbas was the son of Imam Ali, the first Imam and successor of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his progeny). He was the brother of Imam Hussain. Fifty years after the demise of the Prophet Muhammad, his grandson Hussain stood up against Yazid, the tyrant ruler of the time, and refused to pledge allegiance to him. As a result of this protest, Hussain, his family-members, and a small group of his companions were surrounded by Yazidi forces in the desert of Karbala, prevented from water for three days, and, finally, on the Day of Ashura, Hussain with about 100 souls faced an army of 25,000 soldiers. They were given the choice of pledging allegiance to Yazid or face death. In that uneven battle, Hussain chose an honorable death over a disgraceful life under a tyrant like Yazid. It was in that historical event that Abbas was made the commander-in-chief and flag-bearer of Hussaini forces. That battle-field gradually turned into a place of pilgrimage, and today the shrines of both these brothers, with their golden domes, form the skyline of Karbala in Iraq. Brotherhood By his supreme sacrifice, Abbas became a universal soul that transcends time and space. Let us start with concept of brotherhood: Brotherhood can be understood on two different levels, a physical and personal level, and a spiritual and social level. Both aspects are important. However, the brotherhood based on blood relationship should be synchronized with the brotherhood based on spiritual relationship. In c

segments.transliteration: salamu allahi wa salamu mala'ikatihi almuqarrabina
segments.translation: O he who saw al-`Abbas attacking the groups of the sheep-like enemies,
followed by the sons of Haydar, who were as courageous as lions.
I have been told that my son was stricken on the head and had his hand cut!
Woe me for my young lion! Did the stroke of the iron post bow his head?

segments.transliteration: walzzakiyatu alttayyibatu fima taghtadi wa taruhu
segments.translation: Had his sword been in his hand, none could have ever approached him.

segments.arabic:
ـبَ بِرَأْسِهِ مَقْطُوعَ يَدْ
وَيْلِي عَلَىٰ شِبْلي أَمَا
لَ بِرَأْسِهِ ضَرْبُ ٱلْعَمَدْ
لَوْ كانَ سَيْفُكَ فِي يَدَيْـ
ـكَ لَما دَنا مِنْهُ أَحَدْ
segments.translation: Do not call me Ummuâl-Banin (Mother of the sons).
You will remind me of the lions of the lair.
I had sons by whom I was called,

segments.transliteration: likhalafi alnnabiyyi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi almursali
segments.translation: but today, I have no single son!
They were four; like eagles on heights.
They faced death by having their aorta cut off.
The ravenous lances crowded on their bodies.
So, all of them were pierced and stabbed.
Great is my distress! Is it true what they have told
that `Abbasâs right hand was severed?
Peace of Allah and peace of His favorite angels,
His commissioned prophets,
His righteous servants,
all the martyrs, and all the veracious (ones),
and also pure, true blessings that come and go,
be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man jahila haqqaka
segments.translation: I testify to you of submission (to the will of God), honest acceptance as true,
loyalty, and sincerity

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man hala baynaka wa bayna ma'i alfurati
segments.translation: to the descendant of the commissioned Prophet, Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household,

segments.arabic: لِخَلَفِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِ
segments.translation: the chosen grandson (of the Prophet),

segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha munjizun lakum ma wa`adakum
segments.translation: the well knowledgeable guide (to the true religion),

segments.transliteration: ji'tuka yabna amiri almu'minina wafidan ilaykum
segments.translation: the conveying successor,

segments.transliteration: wa qalbi musallimun lakum wa tabi`un
segments.translation: and the wrongfully oppressed one.
So, Allah may reward you on behalf of His Messenger,
the Commander of the Faithful,
al-Hasan, and al-Husayn,
peace of Allah be upon them,
with the best reward
for your steadfastness, dedication (to the sake of God), and support (for the right party).

segments.transliteration: inni bikum wa bi'iyabikum min almu'minina
segments.translation: Very excellent be the reward of the eternal life.

segments.transliteration: wa biman khalafakum wa qatalakum min alkafirina
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who killed you.

segments.transliteration: qatala allahu ummatan qatalatkum bil-aidi wal-alsuni
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who ignored your position
and belittled your sanctity.

segments.transliteration: almuti`u lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who precluded you from having from the water of the Euphrates.

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ حَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مَاءِ ٱلْفُرَاتِ
segments.transliteration: walhasani walhusayni salla allahu `alayhim wa sallama
segments.translation: I testify that you were killed wrongfully

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
segments.translation: and that Allah will verily fulfill His promise that He made with you.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُنْجِزٌ لَكُمْ مَا وَعَدَكُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa maghfiratuhu wa ridwanuhu wa `ala ruhika wa badanika
segments.translation: O son of the Commander of the Faithful, I have come to you to present myself before you.

segments.arabic: جِئْتُكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلُمْؤْمِنينَ وَافِداً إِلَيْكُمْ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu wa ushhidu allaha annaka madayta `ala ma mada bihi albadriyyuna
segments.translation: My heart is submissive to you and is following you.
And I am your follower.
I am ready to support you
until Allah decides.
He is surely the best of all those who decide.
I am verily with you,
not with your enemy.
I am one of those who believe in you and believe in your Return.

segments.transliteration: wa awfa jaza'i ahadin mimman wa fa bibay`atihi
segments.translation: I also one of those who deny your opposites and killers.
Allah may kill the group who killed you with hands and tongues (by giving orders of killing you.)

segments.arabic: قَتَلَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً قَتَلَتْكُمْ بِٱلأَيْدِي وَٱلأَلْسُنِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah)

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad balaghta fi alnnasihati
segments.translation: and obedient to Allah, to His Messenger, to the Commander of the Faithful,
to al-Hasan, and to al-Husayn, peace and greetings of Allah be upon them.

segments.arabic: وَٱلحَسَنِ وَٱلحُسَيْنِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَسَلَّمَ
segments.translation: Peace, Allahâs mercy, blessings,

segments.transliteration: wa ja`ala ruhaka ma`a arwahi alssu`ada'i
segments.translation: forgiveness, and gratifications be upon you, your soul, and your body.

segments.transliteration: wa a`taka min jinanihi afsahaha manzilan
segments.translation: I testify, and call Allah to witness, that you abided by the same course that was taken by the warriors of (the battle of) Badr

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ وَأُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ أَنَّكَ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ مَا مَضَىٰ بِهِ ٱلبَدْرِيُّونَ
segments.translation: and the strivers for Allahâs sake
who sincerely served Him in the battlefields against His enemies,
did their bests for supporting His disciples,
and defended His intimate ones.
So, Allah may reward you the best,

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka lam tahin wa lam tankul
segments.translation: the maximum,

segments.transliteration: wa annaka madayta `ala basiratin min amrika
segments.translation: the most abundant,
and the most conclusive reward that He may give to any one who fulfills his homage,

segments.arabic: وَأَوْفَىٰ جَزَاءِ أَحَدٍ مِمَّنْ وَفَىٰ بِبَيْعَتِهِ
segments.translation: answers the call (of the religion),
and obeys his (divinely elected) leaders.
I testify that you acted extremely sincerely

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قَدْ بَالَغْتَ فِي ٱلنَّصِيحَةِ
segments.translation: and exerted all your efforts (in this regard).
Allah may attach you to the martyrs,

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: add your soul to the souls of the happy ones,

segments.transliteration: wa la tada` li fi hadha almakani almukarrami walmashhadi almu`azzami dhanban illa ghafartahu
segments.translation: give you the largest abode in His Paradise
and the most handsome room,
exalt your mention in `Illiyyin (the most elevated position),
and join you to the Prophets, the veracious ones,
the martyrs, and the righteous ones.
Very excellent is the companionship of such ones.
I testify that you did not lag behind and did not turn away the face,

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تَهِنْ وَلَمْ تَنْكُلْ
segments.transliteration: wa la gha'iban illa hafiztahu wa adnaytahu
segments.translation: and that you left this life with full awareness of the truth,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa la hajatan min hawa'iji alddunya wal-akhirati
segments.translation: following the examples of the righteous ones

segments.transliteration: laka fiha ridan wa liya fiha salahun
segments.translation: and sticking to the Prophets.
So, Allah may gather us with you,

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya aba alfadli al`abbasa ibna amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: with His Messenger, and with His disciples
in the abodes of those who practiced humbly (with their Lord).
He is certainly the most merciful of all the merciful ones.
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and do not leave for me, in this honored place and glorified shrine, any sin that I did but that You forgive it,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَدَعْ لِي فِي هٰذَا ٱلمَكَانِ ٱلمُكَرَّمِ وَٱلمَشْهَدِ ٱلمُعَظَّمِ ذَنْباً إِلاَّ غَفَرْتَهُ
segments.translation: any care but that You relieve it,

segments.transliteration: ashhadu laqad nasahta lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'akhika
segments.translation: any illness but that You cure it,
any defect buth that You cover up,
any source of sustenance but that You expand it,
any item of terror but that You pacify it,

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan istahallat minka almaharima
segments.translation: any disunity but that You reunify it,
any absent one but that You guard it and approach (him to me),
and any single need, among the many needs for this life as well as the life to come

segments.arabic: وَلا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَائِجِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.translation: whose settlement achieves your gratification and my good,

segments.arabic: لَكَ فِيهَا رِضَىٰ وَلِيَ فِيهَا صَلاحٌ
segments.translation: but that You grant it. O He Who is the most merciful of all the merciful ones!
Peace be upon you, O Abuâl-Fadl al-`Abbas the son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَاَ ٱلفَضْلِ ٱلعَبَّاسَ بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.transliteration: alrraghibu fima zahida fihi ghayruhu min alththwabi aljazili
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the successors (of the Prophets).

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the foremost to Islam,

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَوَّلِ ٱلْقَوْمِ إِسْلاَماً
segments.transliteration: wa alhaqaka allahu bidarajati aba'ika fi jannati alnna`imi
segments.translation: the first to believe,

segments.transliteration: allahumma inni ta`arradtu liziyarati awliya'ika raghbatan fi thawabika
segments.translation: the best to have served the religion of Allah,

segments.transliteration: wa raja'an limaghfiratika wa jazili ihsanika
segments.translation: and the most careful for Islam.

segments.transliteration: fa's'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina
segments.translation: I bear witness that you served Allah, His Messenger, and your brother sincerely.

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ لَقَدْ نَصَحْتَ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَخِيكَ
segments.transliteration: wa an taj`ala rizqi bihim darran
segments.translation: You were the most excellent self-sacrificing brother.
So, Allahâs curse be on the group who killed you.
Allahâs curse be on the group who wronged you.
Allahâs curse be on the group who violated your sanctities

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً ٱسْتَحَلَّتْ مِنْكَ ٱلْمَحَارِمَ
segments.translation: and infringed the sanctity of Islam.

segments.transliteration: waj`alni mimman yanqalibu min ziyarati mashahidi ahibba'ika
segments.translation: You were the most excellent steadfast fighter,
protector, supporter,
and brother who defended his brother,
responded to the obedience to his Lord,
and worked desirably for gaining the abundant reward, which others refused,

segments.arabic: ٱلرَّاغِبُ فِيمَا زَهِدَ فِيهِ غَيْرُهُ مِنَ ٱلثَّوَابِ ٱلْجَزِيلِ
segments.transliteration: innaka ahlu alttaqwa wa ahlu almaghfirati
segments.translation: and the nice tribute.
So, Allah may attach you to the rank of your fathers in the gardens of bliss.

segments.arabic: وَأَلْحَقَكَ ٱللَّهُ بِدَرَجَةِ آبَائِكَ فِي جَنَّاتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
segments.translation: O Allah, I have done the pilgrimage to Your disciples out of my desire for (winning) your reward

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي تَعَرَّضْتُ لِزِيَارَةِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ رَغْبَةً فِي ثَوَابِكَ
segments.transliteration: amanna billahi wa birasulihi wa bikitabihi
segments.translation: and my wish for Your forgiveness and Your abundant benevolence.

segments.transliteration: wa bima ja'a bihi min `indi allahi
segments.translation: So, I implore You to send Your blessings upon Muhammad and his immaculate Household

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.translation: and to make my sustenance flow copiously in their names,

segments.transliteration: allahumma la taj`alhu akhira al`ahdi min ziyarati qabra ibni akhi rasulika
segments.translation: my living delightful in their names,
my pilgrimage rewardable in their names,
and my life pleasant in their names,

segments.transliteration: wahshurni ma`ahu wa ma`a aba'ihi fi aljinani
segments.translation: to make me take to the conduct of the honored ones,

segments.transliteration: wa `arrif bayni wa baynahu wa bayna rasulika wa awliya'ika
segments.translation: to make me one of those who, as returning from the pilgrimage to the tombs of Your beloved ones,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ يَنْقَلِبُ مِنْ زِيَارَةِ مَشَاهِدِ أَحِبَّائِكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: win success and prosperity
and deserve forgiveness of sins,
covering up of defects,

segments.transliteration: walwilayati li`aliyyi bni abi talibin wal-a'immati min wuldihi
segments.translation: and relief of disasters.
You are surely worthy of being feared and worthy of forgiving.

segments.transliteration: fa'inni qad raditu ya rabbi bidhalika
segments.translation: I entrust you with Allah, beseech Him to keep you under His guard,

segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: and invoke peace upon you.
We have believed in Allah, in His Messenger, in His Book,
and in that which he conveyed from Allah.

segments.arabic: وَبِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: O Allah, record our names with the witnesses.

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad jahadta wa nasahta
segments.translation: O Allah, do not decide this pilgrimage to the tomb of the son of Your Messengerâs brother to be the last one of mine.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ ٱلعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِي قَبْرَ ٱبْنِ أَخِي رَسُولِكَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon him (i.e. the Messenger) and upon his Household.

segments.transliteration: la`ana allahu alzzalimina lakum min al-awwalina wal-akhirina
segments.translation: Grant me opportunities to visit him so long as You keep me alive,
join me to him and to his fathers in the gardens of Paradise,

segments.arabic: وَٱحْشُرْنِي مَعَهُ وَمَعَ آبَائِهِ فِي ٱلْجِنَانِ
segments.translation: and introduce me to him, to Your Messenger, and to Your disciples.

segments.arabic: وَعَرِّفْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِكَ وَأَوْلِيَائِكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, send Your blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and take me to You while I am abiding by the believing in You,
giving credence to Your Messenger,
being faithful to `Ali the son of Abu-Talib and the Imams from his progeny,

segments.arabic: وَٱلوِلاَيَةِ لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَٱلأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ وُلْدِهِ
segments.translation: and disavowing their enemy.
My Lord, I have accepted such.

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَضِيتُ يَا رَبِّي بِذٰلِكَ
segments.translation: Allah may send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah)
and obedient to Allah and to His Messenger.
I bear witness that you strove (in the way of Allah), acted sincerely,
and tolerated (harm) until death came upon you.
May Allah curse those who wronged you from the past and the present generations

segments.arabic: لَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ لَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلاوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
segments.translation: and may He send them to the lowest layer of the blazing Hell.

text: Dua Mujeer - Duas.org       The Holy Month of Ramadan Dua Mujeer Recited on the Days of 'Ayyamul Baydh' (13th 14th & 15th) This is a supplication of high eminence which is reported to have been brought by Angel Jibreel for the Holy Prophet (pbuh) when he was engrossed in prayers in Maqam-e-Ibrahim. Kafa'ami has reported this supplication in Baladul Amin and in Misbah. It is mentioned by him that the reward for the one reciting it during the Ayyam al-bidh ( i.e. on 13th, 14th & 15th day) of the Holy month of Ramadan , is that his sins are forgiven even if they are in such plenty as the drops of rain water, leaves of trees or sand of a desert. It is also very effective for the cure of the sick, fulfillment of debts, acquisition of wealth and relief from grief. . segments.translation: O Allah! Indeed these two are among Your signs,

And turn away from us their harm and damage,
And do not strike us with calamity through them,
And do not send blight upon our livelihoods.

segments.translation: And turn the mill of Your punishment upon the disbelievers.
O Allah, remove the drought of our land with Your rain,
And bring out the burning of our hearts with Your provision,
And do not distract us from You with anything else,

segments.transliteration: WalÄ taqá¹­aâ âan kÄffatinÄ mÄddata birrik,
segments.translation: And do not cut off from us the flow of Your goodness,
For the truly rich is the one whom You enrich,
And the safe one is the one You protect,
No one besides You has defense,
And no one can resist Your might,

segments.transliteration: Falaka al-á¸¥amdu âalÄ mÄ waqaytanÄ minal-balÄâ,
segments.translation: So praise is Yours for protecting us from affliction,

segments.transliteration: Walaka ash-shukru âalÄ mÄ khawwaltanÄ minan-niâmÄâ,

The Giver of great blessings,
The Accepter of even little praise,
The Thankful for even little gratitude,
The Beneficent, the Generous, the Possessor of bounty,

segments.translation: There is no god but You; to You is the return.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ هذَيْن آيَتَانِ مِنْ آياتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-na hd'ay-ni aaayataani min aaayaatik
segments.translation: 1.O God, these are two of Your signs
2.and these are two of Your helpers.

segments.arabic: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَة نَافِعَة أَوْ نَقِمَة ضَارَّة،
segments.transliteration: yab-tadiraani t'aaa'taka birah'-matin-naafia'tin aw naqimatin z''aaar-rah
segments.translation: 3.They rush to obey You with beneficial mercy or injurious vengeance,
4.so rain not down upon us from them the evil rain
5.and clothe us not through them in the garment of affliction!
6.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَبَرَكَتَهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa anzil a'lay-naa naf-a' had'ihs-sah'aaa-ibi wa barakatahaa
segments.translation: 7.send down upon us the benefit of these clouds and their blessing,
8.turn away from us their harm and their injury,
9.strike us not through them with blight,

segments.transliteration: wa laa tur-sil a'laa maa'ayishinaa a'ahah
segments.translation: 10.and loose not upon our livelihoods any bane!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa in kunta baa'th-tahaa naqimah wa ar-sal-tahaa sakh-t'ah
segments.translation: 11.O God, if You hast incited them as vengeance and loosed them in anger,

segments.translation: 13.and implore You in asking Your pardon!
14.So incline with wrath toward the idolaters
15.and set the millstone of Your vengeance turning upon the heretics
16.O God, take away the barrenness of our lands with Your watering,
17.dislodge the malice from our breasts with Your providing,
18.distract us not from You through other than You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa taq-t'aa' a'n kaaaf-fatinaa maaad-data bir-rik
segments.translation: 19.and cut none of us off from the stuff of Your goodness,
20.for the rich is he to whom You hast given riches,
21.and the safe he whom You hast protected!
22.No one has any defense against You,

segments.transliteration: wa laa bih'adin a'n sat'-watika am-tinaaa'
segments.translation: 23.nor any means to bar Your penalty.

segments.arabic: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ،
segments.transliteration: tah'-kumu bimaa shi-ta a'laa man shi-t

segments.transliteration: wa taq-z''ee bimaaa arat-ta fee man arat-t
segments.translation: 25.and You decreest what You desirest for any whom You desirest!

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segments.translation: 26.So to You belongs praise for protecting us from affliction

segments.arabic: وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النّعْمَاءِ
segments.transliteration: wa lakash-shuk-ru a'laa maa khaw-wal-tanaa minan-naa'-maaa-i
segments.translation: 27.and to You belongs thanks for conferring upon us blessings,
28.a praise which will leave behind the praise of the praisers,
29.a praise which will fill the earth and the heaven!
30.Surely You art the All-kind through immense kindnesses,
31.the Giver of abounding favours,
32.the Accepter of small praise,
33.the Grateful for little gratitude,
34.the Beneficent, the Benevolent, Possessor of graciousness!
