and You provided me with sufficiency in all my affairs,
and You turned away from me the burden of tribulation,
and You averted from me the feared decree.

segments.arabic: إلهِي فَكَمْ مِنْ بَلاء جَاهِد قَدْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: IlÄhÄ« fa-kam min balÄâin jÄhidin qad á¹£arafta âannÄ«,
segments.translation: My God, how many an arduous tribulation You have turned away from me,

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَة سَابِغَة أَقْرَرْتَ بِهَا عَيْنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-kam min niâmatin sÄbighatin aqrarta bihÄ âaynÄ«,
segments.translation: and how many a full blessing You have delighted my eye with,

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ صَنِيعَة كَرِيمَة لَكَ عِنْدِي.
segments.transliteration: wa-kam min á¹£anÄ«âatin karÄ«matin lak âindÄ«.
segments.translation: and how many a noble favour You have with me.

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَجَبْتَ عِنْدَ الاضْطِرَارِ دَعْوَتِي،
segments.transliteration: Anta l-ladhÄ« ajabta âinda l-iá¸á¹­irÄri daâwatÄ«,
segments.translation: You are the One Who answered my prayer when I was in dire need,
and You overlooked my slip when I stumbled,
and You took my due from the enemies for my being wronged.

segments.arabic: إلهِي مَا وَجَدْتُكَ بَخِيلاً حِينَ سَأَلْتُكَ،
segments.transliteration: IlÄhÄ« mÄ wajadtuka bakhÄ«lan á¸¥Ä«na saâaltuk,
segments.translation: My God, I have not found You stingy when I asked You,
and not holding back when I desired You,

segments.arabic: بل وَجَدْتُكَ لِدُعَآئِي سَامِعاً، وَلِمَطَالِبِي مُعْطِياً،
segments.transliteration: bal wajadtuka li-duâÄâÄ« sÄmiâan, wa-li-maá¹­ÄlibÄ« muâá¹­iyÄ,
segments.translation: Rather, I found You hearing my prayer, and granting my requests,
and I found Your bounty upon me full,

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ شَأْن مِنْ شَأْنِي، وَكُلِّ زَمَان مِنْ زَمَانِي،
segments.transliteration: fÄ« kulli shaânin min shaânÄ«, wa-kulli zamÄnin min zamÄnÄ«,
segments.translation: in every affair of mine, and every time of my time,

segments.arabic: فَأَنْتَ عِنْدِي مَحْمُودٌ، وَصَنِيعُكَ لَدَيَّ مَبْرُورٌ،
segments.transliteration: fa-anta âindÄ« maá¸¥mÅ«d, wa-á¹£anÄ«âuk ladayya mabrÅ«r,
segments.translation: so You are praised by me, and Your work is approved by me.

segments.arabic: تَحْمَدُكَ نَفْسِي وَلِسَانِيْ وَعَقْلِي حَمْداً يَبْلُغُ الوَفَآءَ وَحَقِيقَةَ الشُّكْرِ،
segments.transliteration: taá¸¥maduk nafsÄ« wa-lisÄnÄ« wa-âaqlÄ« á¸¥amdan yablughu l-wafÄâa wa-á¸¥aqÄ«qata sh-shukr,
segments.translation: My soul, my tongue, and my intellect praise You with a praise that reaches fulfillment and the reality of thanks,
a praise that is the extent of Your good pleasure with me.

segments.arabic: فَنَجِّنِي مِنْ سَخَطِكَ يَا كَهْفِي حِينَ تُعْيينِي الْمَذَاهِبُ،
segments.transliteration: fa-najjinÄ« min sakhaá¹­ika yÄ kahfÄ« á¸¥Ä«na tuâyÄ«nÄ« l-madhÄhib,
segments.translation: So deliver me from Your displeasure, O my refuge when the paths weary me,
and O One Who overlooks my slip,

segments.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ سَتْرُكَ عَوْرَتِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَفْضُوحِينَ،
segments.transliteration: fa-lawlÄ satruk âawratÄ« la-kuntu mina l-mafá¸Å«á¸¥Ä«n,
segments.translation: for were it not for Your concealment of my fault, I would have been among the disgraced,
and O One Who strengthens me with help,

segments.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ نَصْرُكَ إيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَغْلُوبِينَ،
segments.transliteration: fa-lawlÄ naá¹£ruk iyyÄya la-kuntu mina l-maghlÅ«bÄ«n,
segments.translation: for were it not for Your helping me, I would have been among the overcome,

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ وَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ الْمَذَلَّةِ عَلى أَعْنَاقِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa-yÄ man waá¸aâat lahu l-mulÅ«ku nÄ«ra l-madhallati âalÄ aânÄqihÄ,
segments.translation: and O You for whom the kings have placed the yoke of humiliation upon their necks,

segments.arabic: فَهُمْ مِنْ سَطَواتِهِ خَائِفُونَ، وَيَا أَهْلَ التَّقْوَى،
segments.transliteration: fa-hum min saá¹­awÄtihÄ« khÄâifÅ«n, wa-yÄ Ahl at-TaqwÄ,
segments.translation: so they are fearful of His assaults, and O You who are worthy of reverent fear (TaqwÄ),

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لَهُ الأَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنى أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa-yÄ man lahu l-asmÄâu l-á¸¥usnÄ asâaluka an taâfuwa âannÄ«,
segments.translation: and O You to whom belong the Beautiful Names (al-AsmÄâ al-á¸¤usnÄ), I ask You to pardon me,
and to forgive me, for I am not innocent, so that I may excuse myself,
nor am I possessed of strength, so that I may triumph,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَفَرَّ لِي فَأَفِرَّ. وَأَسْتَقِيْلُكَ عَثَراتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ mafarra lÄ« fa-afirra. Wa-astaqÄ«luka âatharÄtÄ«,
segments.translation: nor is there a way for me to escape, so that I may flee. And I ask You to overlook my slips,

segments.arabic: وَأَتَنَصَّلُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي الَّتِي قَدْ أَوْبَقَتْنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-atanassalu ilayk min dhunÅ«bÄ« l-latÄ« qad awbaqatnÄ«,
segments.translation: and I disavow to You my sins that have surely ruined me,
and surrounded me so that they destroyed me.
From them I have fled to You, Lord, repentingâ
so accept my repentance; seeking refuge, so grant me refuge; seeking protectionâ

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي سَآئِلاً، فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي مُعْتَصِماً،
segments.transliteration: fa-lÄ takhdhulnÄ« sÄâilan, fa-lÄ taá¸¥rimnÄ« muâtaá¹£iman,
segments.translation: so do not forsake me; a petitioner, so do not deprive me; holding fastâ

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تُسْلِمْنِي دَاعِياً، فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً،
segments.transliteration: fa-lÄ tuslimnÄ« dÄâiyan, fa-lÄ taruddanÄ« khÄâiban,
segments.translation: so do not abandon me; a caller, so do not turn me back disappointed.
I called upon You, O Lord, as one destitute, humbled,

segments.arabic: مُشْفِقاً، خَائِفاً، وَجِلاً، فَقِيراً، مُضْطَرّاً، إلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: mushfiqan, khÄâifan, wajilÄ, faqÄ«ran, muá¸á¹­arran, ilayk
segments.translation: anxious, fearful, apprehensive, poor, compelled (to turn) to Youâ

segments.arabic: أَشْكُو إلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي ضَعْفَ نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: ashkÅ« ilayk yÄ IlÄhÄ« á¸aâfa nafsÄ«
segments.translation: I complain to You, O my God, of the weakness of my soul
to hasten to what You promised Your friends,
and to shun what You warned Your enemies against,
and the abundance of my worries and the whispering of my soul.
My God, You have not disgraced me because of my hidden sin,
and You have not destroyed me because of my crime; I call You, and You answer me
even though I am slow when You call me.
And I ask You for all that I wish of my needs,

segments.arabic: وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنْتُ وَضَعْتُ عِنْدَكَ سِرِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa-á¸¥aythu mÄ kuntu waá¸aâtu âindak sirrÄ«,
segments.translation: and wherever I was, I placed my secret with You,

segments.arabic: فَلاَ أَدْعُو سِوَاكَ، وَلاَ أَرْجُو غَيْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: fa-lÄ adâÅ« siwÄk, wa-lÄ arjÅ« ghayrak,
segments.translation: so I do not call upon anyone other than You, nor do I hope for anyone other than You.

segments.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ، تَسْمَعُ مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: Labbayk, labbayk, tasmaâu man shakÄ ilayk,
segments.translation: At Your service, at Your service! You hear the one who complains to You,
and You meet the one who relies on You,
and You deliver the one who holds fast to You,
and You bring relief to the one who seeks shelter in You.

segments.arabic: إلهِي فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي خَيْرَ الآخِرَةِ وَالأُولى لِقِلَّةِ شُكْرِي،
segments.transliteration: IlÄhÄ« fa-lÄ taá¸¥rimnÄ« khayra l-Äkhirati wa-l-Å«lÄ li-qillati shukrÄ«,
segments.translation: My God, do not deprive me of the good of the Hereafter and the first life (the world) because of the fewness of my thanks,

segments.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-ghfir lÄ« mÄ taâlamu min dhunÅ«bÄ«,
segments.translation: and forgive me what You know of my sins.
If You punish, then I am the wrongdoer, the negligent,
the waster, the sinner, the failing, the one lying down (in neglect),
the one heedless of his soul's portion,
and if You forgive, then You are the Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

segments.arabic: إلهِي أَحْمَـدُكَ ـ وَأَنْتَ لِلْحَمْدِ أَهْلٌ ـ
segments.transliteration: ilaaheee ah'-maduk wa anta lil-h'am-di ah-lun
segments.translation: 1.My God, I praise You, - and You art worthy of praise -

segments.arabic: عَلَى حُسْنِ صَنِيعِكَ إلَيَّ، وَسُبُـوغِ نَعْمَآئِكَ عَلَيَّ،
segments.transliteration: a'laa h'us-ni s'aneei'ka ilay wa subooghi naa'-maaa-ika a'lay
segments.translation: 2.for Your benefaction toward me, the lavishness of Your favours toward me,
3.and Your plentiful bestowal upon me,
4.and for showing bounty toward me through Your mercy
5.and lavishing Your favour upon me.

segments.arabic: فَقَدِ اصْطَنَعْتَ عِنْدِي ما يَعْجِزُ عَنُهُ شُكْرِي، وَلَوْلاَ إحْسَانُكَ، إلَيَّ
segments.transliteration: faqadi as'-t'anaa'-ta i'ndee maa yaa'-jizu a'n-hoo shuk-ree wa law-laaa ih'-saanuka ilay
segments.translation: 6.You hast done well toward me and I am incapable of thanking You. Were it not for Your beneficence toward me
7.and the lavishness of Your favours upon me,

segments.arabic: مَا  بَلَغْتُ إحْرازَ حَظِّي، وَلاَ إصْلاَحَ نَفْسِي،
segments.transliteration: maa balagh-tu ih'-raaza h'az'-z'ee wa laaa is'-laah'a naf-see
segments.translation: 8.I would not have reached the taking of my share nor would my soul have been set right,
9.but You began with beneficence toward me,
10.provided me sufficiency in all my affairs,
11.turned away from me the toil of affliction,
12.and held back from me the feared decree.

segments.arabic: إلهِي فَكَمْ مِنْ بَلاء جَاهِد قَدْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: ilaahee fakam mim-balaaa-in jaahidin qad s'araf-ta a'n-nee
segments.translation: 13.My God, how many a toilsome affliction which You hast turned away from me!

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَة سَابِغَة أَقْرَرْتَ بِهَا عَيْنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa kam min-nia'-matin saabighatin aq-rar-ta bihaa a'y-nee
segments.translation: 14.How many a lavish favour with which You hast gladdened my eye!

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ صَنِيعَة كَرِيمَة  لَكَ عِنْدِي.
segments.transliteration: wa kam min s'aneea'tin kareematil-laka i'ndee
segments.translation: 15.How many a generous benefaction of Thine which is present with me!

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَجَبْتَ عِنْدَ الاضْطِرَارِ دَعْوَتِي،
segments.translation: 16.It is You who responded to my supplication at the time of distress,
17.released me from my slip in stumbling,
18.and took my enemies to task for doing wrong to me.

segments.arabic: إلهِي مَا وَجَدْتُكَ بَخِيلاً حِينَ سَأَلْتُكَ،
segments.transliteration: ilaahee maa wajat-tuk bakheelana h'eena saal-tuk
segments.translation: 19.My God, I did not find You a miser when I asked of You
20.nor a withholder when I desired from You.

segments.arabic: بل وَجَدْتُكَ لِدُعَآئِي سَامِعاً، وَلِمَطَالِبِي مُعْطِياً،
segments.transliteration: bal wajat-tuka lidua'aa-ee saamia'a wa limat'aalibee mua'-t'eeaa
segments.translation: 21.No, 1 found You a hearer of my supplication and a bestower of my requests;
22.I found Your favours toward me

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ شَأْن مِنْ شَأْنِي، وَكُلِّ زَمَان مِنْ زَمَانِي،
segments.transliteration: fee kul-li shaa-nim-min shaa-nee wa kul-li zamaanim-min zamaanee
segments.translation: 23.lavish in my every situation and in my every time.

segments.arabic: فَأَنْتَ عِنْدِي مَحْمُودٌ، وَصَنِيعُكَ لَدَيَّ مَبْرُورٌ،
segments.transliteration: faanta i'ndee mah'-mood wa s'aneeu'ka laday-ya mab-roor
segments.translation: 24.So You art praised by me and Your benefaction honoured.

segments.arabic: تَحْمَدُكَ نَفْسِي وَلِسَانِيْ وَعَقْلِي حَمْداً يَبْلُغُ الوَفَآءَ وَحَقِيقَةَ الشُّكْرِ،
segments.transliteration: tah'-maduka naf-see walisaanee wa a'q-lee h'am-day-yab-lughul-wafaaa-a wa h'aqeeqatash-shuk-r
segments.translation: 25.My soul, my tongue, and my intelligence praise You, a praise that reaches fulfilment and the reality of thanksgiving,
26.a praise that attains to Your good pleasure with me -

segments.arabic: فَنَجِّنِي مِنْ سَخَطِكَ يَا كَهْفِي حِينَ تُعْيينِي الْمَذَاهِبُ،
segments.transliteration: fanaj-jinee min sakhat'ik yaa kah-fee h'eena tua'-yeeneel-mad'aahib
segments.translation: 27.so deliver me from Your displeasure! O my cave when the ways thwart me!
28.O He who releases me from my stumble!

segments.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ سَتْرُكَ عَوْرَتِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَفْضُوحِينَ،
segments.translation: 29.Were it not for Your covering my shameful defects, I would be one of the disgraced.
30.O my confirmer through help!

segments.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ نَصْرُكَ إيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَغْلُوبِينَ،
segments.translation: 31.Were it not for Your helping me, I would be one of the overcome!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ وَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ الْمَذَلَّةِ عَلى أَعْنَاقِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa maw-waz''aa't lahul-mulwku neeral-mad'al-lati a'laaa aa'-naaqihaa
segments.translation: 32.O He before whom kings place the yoke of lowliness around their necks,

segments.arabic: فَهُمْ مِنْ سَطَواتِهِ خَائِفُونَ، وَيَا أَهْلَ التَّقْوَى،
segments.transliteration: fahum min sat'awaatihee khaaa-ifoon wa yaaa ah-lat-taq-waa
segments.translation: 33.fearing His penalties! O worthy of reverent fear!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لَهُ الأَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنى أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-lahul-as-maaa-ul-h'us-naa as-aluka an taa'-fuwa a'n-nee
segments.translation: 34.O He to whom belong the names most beautiful! I ask You to pardon me

segments.transliteration: wa tagh-fira lee falas-tu baree-ana faaa'-tad'ir
segments.translation: 35.and to forgive me, for I am not innocent that I should offer excuses,
36.nor a possessor of strength that I should gain victory,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَفَرَّ لِي فَأَفِرَّ. وَأَسْتَقِيْلُكَ عَثَراتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa mafar-ra lee faafir wa as-taqeeluka a'tharaatee
segments.translation: 37.nor have I any place of flight that I should flee! I ask You to release me from my stumbles,

segments.arabic: وَأَتَنَصَّلُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي الَّتِي قَدْ أَوْبَقَتْنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa atanas'-s'alu ilay-ka min d'unwbeeal-latee qad aw-baqat-nee
segments.translation: 38.and before You I disavow my sins, which have laid me waste,
39.encompassed me, and destroyed me!
40.I flee from them to You, my Lord, turning repentantly,
41.so turn toward me, seeking refuge, so grant me refuge, asking sanctuary,

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي سَآئِلاً، فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي مُعْتَصِماً،
segments.transliteration: falaa takh-d'ul-nee saaa-ilana falaa tah'-rim-nee mua'-tas'imana
segments.translation: 42.so abandon me not, requesting, so deprive me not, holding fast,

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تُسْلِمْنِي دَاعِياً، فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً،
segments.transliteration: falaa tus-lim-nee daae'eana falaa tarud-danee khaaa-ibaa
segments.translation: 43.so leave me not, supplicating, so send me not back disappointed!
44.I have supplicated You, my Lord, as one miserable, abased,

segments.arabic: مُشْفِقاً، خَائِفاً، وَجِلاً، فَقِيراً، مُضْطَرّاً، إلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: mush-fiqana khaaa-ifaa wajilana faqeeraa muz''-t'ar-ran ilay-k
segments.translation: 45.apprehensive, fearful, quaking, poor, driven to have recourse to You!

segments.arabic: أَشْكُو إلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي ضَعْفَ نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: ash-kw ilay-ka yaaa ilaahee z''aa'-fa naf-see
segments.translation: 46.I complain to You, my God, of my soul - which is too weak
47.to hurry to that which You hast promised Your friends
48.or to avoid that against which You hast cautioned Your enemies -

segments.transliteration: wa kath-rata humoomee wa was-wasata naf-see
segments.translation: 49.and of the multitude of my concerns, and of my soul's confusing thoughts.
50.My God, You hast not disgraced me through my secret thoughts

segments.transliteration: wa lam tuh-lik-nee bijareeratee ad-u'wka fatujeebunee
segments.translation: 51.or destroyed me because of my misdeeds! I call upon You, and You respondest,

segments.transliteration: wa in kuntu bat'ee-ana h'eena tad-u'wnee
segments.translation: 52.even if I am slow when You callest upon me.

segments.transliteration: wa as-aluka kul-lamaa shi-tu min h'awaaa-ijee
segments.translation: 53.I ask You everything I want of my needs,

segments.arabic: وَحَيْثُ  مَا كُنْتُ وَضَعْتُ عِنْدَكَ سِرِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa h'ay-thu maa kuntu waz''aa'-tu i'ndaka sir-ree
segments.translation: 54.and I deposit with You my secret wherever I may be.

segments.arabic: فَلاَ أَدْعُو سِوَاكَ، وَلاَ أَرْجُو غَيْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: falaaa ad-u'w siwaak wa laaa ar-joo ghay-rak
segments.translation: 55.I supplicate no one besides You, and I hope for no one other than You.

segments.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ، تَسْمَعُ مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: lab-bay-ka lab-bay-k tas-mau' man shakaaa ilay-k
segments.translation: 56.At Your service! At Your service! You hearest him who complains to You!
57.You receivest him who has confidence in You!
58.You savest him who holds fast to You!
59.You givest relief to him who seeks shelter in You!

segments.arabic: إلهِي  فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي خَيْرَ الآخِرَةِ وَالأُولى لِقِلَّةِ شُكْرِي،
segments.transliteration: ilaahee falaa tah'-rim-nee khay-ral-akhirati wal-oolaa  liqil-lati shuk-ree
segments.translation: 60.My God, so deprive me not of the good of the last world and the first because of the paucity of my thanksgiving

segments.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي،
segments.transliteration: wagh-fir lee maa taa'-lamu min d'unoobee
segments.translation: 61.and forgive me the sins of mine which You knowest!
62.If You chastisest, I am the wrongdoer, the neglecter,
63.the negligent, the sinner, the derelict, the sluggard,
64.the heedless of the share of my soul!
65.And if You forgivest - You art the Most Merciful of the merciful!
